h1: Custom Direct to Film Jerseys for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Jerseys | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film jerseys in bulk for your team or event. Vibrant, durable prints from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film printing offers a cost-effective way to add vibrant, high-detail artwork to custom jerseys without the setup fees of screen printing. This method works especially well for small to medium runs, making it a practical choice for corporate sports teams, charity events, or employee uniform programs that need quick turnaround and full-color designs. The durable transfer bonds firmly to polyester and poly-blend fabrics, so your logo stays sharp through repeated washing and game-day wear.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film jerseys with full-color team logos printed on moisture-wicking polyester fabric
